description:
`DownloadAuthorizer.Authorize()` returns a presigned S3 URL but does not track whether the download completed (Finding 4). Add a lightweight delivery-confirmation mechanism - either an S3 access-log ingestion path or a signed callback/redirect URL that confirms bytes were served - and record confirmation alongside the authorization record.

On repeated authorizations for the same `(email, asset)` pair without confirmation within a threshold, emit a `payment_anomaly_log` row (type `authorization_without_fulfillment`). Consumes the alert pipeline from execute/lpbs-payment-anomaly-log-and-alerts.
name: lpbs-download-delivery-confirmation
title: Download authorization to delivery confirmation tracking
